as_told.title: Immaculate Constellation revealed at congressional hearings

plain: A podcast host named Jesse Michels says that in late 2024 there were hearings on Capitol Hill in Washington, first in the House of Representatives and then in the Senate, that brought to light a secret programme called Immaculate Constellation. In a later episode he leaves out the Senate and calls it simply a top-secret programme. If it is real, it would mean the government has been running a hidden effort on these questions.
